parts.text: The change described in the 28 Credit Revision dated 11 January 2024 is a reduction in the credit requirements for Under Graduate Minor Specialization. The credit requirement has been reduced from 20 credits to 15 credits. Additionally, the credit requirement for Minor/Specialization will include 8 credits for specialization compulsory courses and 7 credits for specialization elective courses.
